WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('quarter', (SELECT max(COALESCE(ended_at, started_at)) FROM fct_subscriptions)) AS q_start
), q AS (
  SELECT q_start, q_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS q_end FROM bounds
)
SELECT
  q.q_start AS quarter_start,
  q.q_end AS quarter_end,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.churned_at >= q.q_start AND c.churned_at < q.q_end THEN c.customer_id END) AS churned_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.signup_date < q.q_end AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.q_start) AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE THEN c.customer_id END) AS active_at_start,
  1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.churned_at >= q.q_start AND c.churned_at < q.q_end THEN c.customer_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.signup_date < q.q_end AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.q_start) AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE THEN c.customer_id END), 0) AS churn_rate
FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN q
GROUP BY q.q_start, q.q_end;

  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
cogs_dedup AS (
  SELECT period_month, MAX(amount) AS amount
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE source = 'cost_of_revenue'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
costs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs FROM cogs_dedup
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue,
  costs.total_cogs,
  (revenue.total_revenue - costs.total_cogs) AS gross_profit,
  (revenue.total_revenue - costs.total_cogs) / NULLIF(revenue.total_revenue, 0) AS gross_margin
FROM revenue, costs;

model_sql:
WITH active_subs AS (
  SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.mrr, s.started_at, s.ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.mrr > 0
),
arr_at_start AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
arr_now AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_jan_1_2026,
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_now)      AS arr_current,
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_now) - (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_ytd_growth

model_sql:
WITH q1_start AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS ts), q1_end AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS ts), eligible_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q1_start)
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT ts FROM q1_start))
), starting_mrr AS (
  SELECT SUM(GREATEST(s.mrr, 0)) AS mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q1_start)
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT ts FROM q1_start))
), cancelled_subs AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= (SELECT ts FROM q1_start)
    AND s.ended_at < (SELECT ts FROM q1_end)
), classified AS (
  SELECT cs.sub_id, cs.customer_id, cs.mrr AS old_mrr, cs.ended_at,
    (SELECT ns.mrr FROM fct_subscriptions ns
      WHERE ns.customer_id = cs.customer_id
        AND ns.status = 'active'
        AND ns.started_at >= cs.ended_at
        AND ns.started_at <= cs.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      ORDER BY ns.started_at LIMIT 1) AS next_mrr
  FROM cancelled_subs cs
), losses AS (
  SELECT SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN next_mrr IS NULL THEN GREATEST(old_mrr, 0)
      WHEN next_mrr < old_mrr THEN GREATEST(old_mrr, 0) - GREATEST(next_mrr, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS churn_and_downgrade_mrr
  FROM classified
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
  COALESCE((SELECT churn_and_downgrade_mrr FROM losses), 0) AS lost_mrr,
  ((SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr) - COALESCE((SELECT churn_and_downgrade_mrr FROM losses), 0)) / NULLIF((SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr), 0) AS gross_retention

WITH paid_2025 AS (
  SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
    AND (
      (i.processor = 'stripe' AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND i.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
      OR (i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' AND (i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND (i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    )
),
customer_rev AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS rev_2025
  FROM paid_2025
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
churn_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND c.churned_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01' OR (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')), 0) AS churn_rate
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  AVG(rev_2025) AS arpu_2025,
  (SELECT churn_rate FROM churn_2025) AS churn_rate_2025,
  0.75 AS gross_margin,
  (AVG(rev_2025) * 0.75) / NULLIF((SELECT churn_rate FROM churn_2025), 0) AS ltv
FROM customer_rev;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.customer_id, s.mrr, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.status
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false OR c.is_test IS NULL
),
start_cohort AS (
  -- customers active at start of Q1 2026 with their starting MRR
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS start_mrr
  FROM base
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
    AND mrr > 0
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
end_mrr AS (
  -- same cohort's MRR at end of Q1 2026
  SELECT b.customer_id, SUM(b.mrr) AS end_mrr
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM start_cohort)
    AND b.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
    AND b.mrr > 0
  GROUP BY b.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.start_mrr), 0) AS net_revenue_retention_q1_2026,
  SUM(s.start_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
  SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) AS ending_mrr_from_cohort
FROM start_cohort s
LEFT JOIN end_mrr e USING (customer_id);

model_sql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    event_type,
    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ELSE timestamp END AS event_ts_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value') AS DOUBLE),
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue') AS DOUBLE)
    ) AS deal_value,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')
),
-- Q2 FY2026 assumed calendar: 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30; 'going into' = as of 2026-04-01
open_pipeline AS (
  SELECT SUM(c.deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
  FROM (SELECT * FROM normalized WHERE event_type = 'opp_created' AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM normalized x
    WHERE x.opp_id = c.opp_id
      AND x.event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')
      AND x.event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
  )
),
q2_closed_won AS (
  SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS q2_won_value
  FROM normalized
  WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
    AND event_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND event_ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  op.open_pipeline_value,
  qw.q2_won_value AS q2_quota_proxy_won,
  CASE WHEN qw.q2_won_value > 0 THEN op.open_pipeline_value / qw.q2_won_value END AS pipeline_coverage_ratio
FROM open_pipeline op CROSS JOIN q2_closed_won qw;

),

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n

),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n
  FROM dim_customers c, period p
  WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
    AND c.churned_at >= p.q_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.q_end
)
SELECT
  p.q_start AS quarter_start,
  p.q_end AS quarter_end,
  a.n AS customers_active_at_start,
  ch.n AS customers_churned,
  CAST(ch.n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(a.n, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM period p, active_at_start a, churned_in_period ch;

  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01')
),
cancellations AS (
  SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.ended_at, s.mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
    AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2024-04-01'
),
true_churn_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.customer_id
  FROM cancellations x
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fct_subscriptions n
    WHERE n.customer_id = x.customer_id
      AND n.status = 'active'
      AND n.started_at >= x.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND n.started_at <= x.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  )
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churn_customers) AS churned_customers,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_start)         AS active_customers_at_period_start,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churn_customers) AS DOUBLE)
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_start), 0) AS churn_rate_q1_2024

model_sql:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS curr_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS curr_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
),
true_churn_subs AS (
  -- cancelled subs that are NOT downgrade-cancellations
  SELECT s.*
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_subscriptions n
      WHERE n.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND n.status = 'active'
        AND ABS(EPOCH(n.started_at - s.ended_at)) <= 86400
        AND n.mrr < s.mrr
    )
),
churned_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    MIN(t.ended_at) AS churn_ts
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN true_churn_subs t ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'current_quarter' AS period,
    q.curr_q_start AS period_start,
    q.curr_q_end AS period_end,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_customers c
      WHERE c.is_test = false
        AND c.signup_date < q.curr_q_start
        AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.curr_q_start)) AS active_at_start,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_customers cc
      WHERE cc.churn_ts >= q.curr_q_start AND cc.churn_ts < q.curr_q_end) AS churned_in_period
  FROM quarters q
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'previous_quarter',
    q.prev_q_start,
    q.prev_q_end,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_customers c
      WHERE c.is_test = false
        AND c.signup_date < q.prev_q_start
        AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start)),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_customers cc
      WHERE cc.churn_ts >= q.prev_q_start AND cc.churn_ts < q.prev_q_end)
  FROM quarters q
)
SELECT
  period,
  period_start,
  period_end,
  active_at_start,
  churned_in_period,
  CASE WHEN active_at_start > 0
       THEN churned_in_period::DOUBLE / active_at_start
       ELSE NULL END AS churn_rate
FROM period_metrics
ORDER BY period_start;

FROM fct_subscriptions s
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
CROSS JOIN latest_closed_month lcm
WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, false) = false
  AND s.status IN ('active','paused')
  AND s.mrr > 0
  AND s.started_at < lcm.month_end
  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= lcm.month_end)
GROUP BY lcm.month_start;

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_q,
         DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) = q.current_q THEN 'current_quarter'
    WHEN DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) = q.prev_q THEN 'previous_quarter'
  END AS period,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS churn_rate_pct
FROM fct_subscriptions s
CROSS JOIN quarters q
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) IN (q.current_q, q.prev_q)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS current_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
)
SELECT
  'current_quarter' AS period,
  q.current_q_start AS quarter_start,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr END), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS churn_rate
FROM stg_subscriptions s
CROSS JOIN quarters q
WHERE s.ended_at >= q.current_q_start AND s.ended_at < q.current_q_end
GROUP BY q.current_q_start
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'previous_quarter' AS period,
  q.prev_q_start AS quarter_start,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr END), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS churn_rate
FROM stg_subscriptions s
CROSS JOIN quarters q
WHERE s.ended_at >= q.prev_q_start AND s.ended_at < q.prev_q_end
GROUP BY q.prev_q_start
ORDER BY quarter_start

WITH starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

model_sql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-04-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(LEAST(e.arr_end, s.arr_start))::float
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::float
              / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS curr_start, DATE '2026-04-01' AS curr_end,
         DATE '2025-10-01' AS prev_start, DATE '2026-01-01' AS prev_end
),
curr_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id, params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.curr_start
    AND s.started_at < p.curr_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.curr_start)
),
curr_churned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c, params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.curr_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.curr_end
),
prev_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id, params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.prev_start
    AND s.started_at < p.prev_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.prev_start)
),
prev_churned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c, params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.prev_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.prev_end
)
SELECT
  'current_quarter' AS period,
  DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
  DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM curr_cohort cc WHERE cc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM curr_churned))::float
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM curr_cohort), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'previous_quarter' AS period,
  DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
  DATE '2025-12-31' AS period_end,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prev_cohort pc WHERE pc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM prev_churned))::float
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prev_cohort), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct

)
SELECT won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes

FROM customer_churn;

    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), customer_churn AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN dc.churned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM fct_subscriptions fs
                WHERE fs.customer_id = cb.customer_id
                  AND fs.ended_at IS NOT NULL
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_churned
    FROM customer_base cb
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers dc
        ON dc.customer_id = cb.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(is_churned) AS churned_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_churned) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS churn_rate_pct
FROM customer_churn;

WITH arr_points AS (
  SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS as_of_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date
), arr_by_date AS (
  SELECT
    p.as_of_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr * 12), 0) AS arr
  FROM arr_points p
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    ON s.started_at::DATE <= p.as_of_date
   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at::DATE > p.as_of_date)
   AND COALESCE(LOWER(s.status), '') IN ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due')
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE OR c.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) AS arr_start_of_ytd,
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END) AS arr_current,
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END) - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) AS arr_growth_ytd,
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END) - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END))
         / MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END)
  END AS arr_growth_ytd_pct
FROM arr_by_date;

    FROM dim_customers d

        ELSE CAST(c.customers_churned_in_q4 AS DOUBLE) / b.customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM churned_customers c

    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id

        c.is_test,
        c.churned_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions s

    signup_date,

  FROM dim_customers

subscription_status AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_started_at,
    MAX(ended_at) AS last_ended_at,
    COUNT(*) AS subscription_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS ended_subscription_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active') AS active_status_rows
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.signup_date,
  c.churned_at,
  s.first_started_at,
  s.last_ended_at,
  s.subscription_rows,
  s.ended_subscription_rows,
  s.active_status_rows,

    WHEN c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.last_ended_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at <> s.last_ended_at) THEN 'customer churn timestamp does not align with subscription end timestamp'
    WHEN c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND s.active_status_rows > 0 THEN 'customer marked churned while having an active subscription row'
    WHEN c.churned_at IS NULL AND s.ended_subscription_rows = subscription_rows AND subscription_rows > 0 THEN 'all subscriptions ended but customer not marked churned'
    WHEN c.signup_date IS NOT NULL AND s.first_started_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signup_date > CAST(s.first_started_at AS DATE) THEN 'customer signup_date occurs after subscription start'
    ELSE 'no obvious mismatch'
  END AS suspected_issue
FROM customer_status c
LEFT JOIN subscription_status s
  ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND (
    (c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.last_ended_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at <> s.last_ended_at))
    OR (c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND s.active_status_rows > 0)
    OR (c.churned_at IS NULL AND s.ended_subscription_rows = subscription_rows AND subscription_rows > 0)
    OR (c.signup_date IS NOT NULL AND s.first_started_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signup_date > CAST(s.first_started_at AS DATE))
  )
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
), customer_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
), quarter_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        'current_quarter' AS quarter_label,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN dc.churned_at >= qb.current_q_start
             AND dc.churned_at < qb.next_q_start
            THEN dc.customer_id END
        ) AS churned_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN dc.signup_date < qb.next_q_start
             AND (dc.churned_at IS NULL OR dc.churned_at >= qb.current_q_start)
            THEN dc.customer_id END
        ) AS customers_at_start
    FROM customer_base cb
    JOIN dim_customers dc ON dc.customer_id = cb.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds qb

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN dc.churned_at >= qb.prev_q_start
             AND dc.churned_at < qb.current_q_start
            THEN dc.customer_id END
        ) AS churned_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN dc.signup_date < qb.current_q_start
             AND (dc.churned_at IS NULL OR dc.churned_at >= qb.prev_q_start)
            THEN dc.customer_id END
        ) AS customers_at_start
    FROM customer_base cb
    JOIN dim_customers dc ON dc.customer_id = cb.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds qb
)
SELECT
    quarter_label,
    churned_customers,
    customers_at_start,
    CASE
        WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_metrics
ORDER BY CASE quarter_label WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), cogs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
  FROM (
    SELECT period_month, amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY period_month
             ORDER BY CASE source
               WHEN 'cost_of_revenue' THEN 1
               WHEN 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN 2
               ELSE 3
             END
           ) AS rn
    FROM fct_cogs
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue,
  cogs.total_cogs,
  (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) AS gross_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue.total_revenue = 0 OR revenue.total_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / revenue.total_revenue
  END AS gross_margin
FROM revenue
CROSS JOIN cogs;

    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s
          WHERE s.customer_id = c.customer_id
            AND s.started_at < q.q_start
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
            AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
      )
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.q_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.q_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
      )
),
counts AS (
    SELECT

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_customers) AS starting_customers
)

    churned_customers,
    starting_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN starting_customers = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / starting_customers
    END AS churn_rate
FROM counts;

  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND i.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
), cogs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE source = 'cost_of_revenue'
    AND period_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue AS revenue,
  cogs.total_cogs AS cogs,
  (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) AS gross_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue.total_revenue = 0 OR revenue.total_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / revenue.total_revenue
  END AS gross_margin
FROM revenue
CROSS JOIN cogs;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
starting_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
),
subs_with_next AS (
    SELECT
        ss.*,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM fct_subscriptions n
            CROSS JOIN params p
            WHERE n.customer_id = ss.customer_id
              AND n.status = 'active'
              AND n.started_at >= ss.ended_at
              AND n.started_at <= ss.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND n.started_at < p.q_end
              AND n.mrr >= 0
              AND n.mrr < ss.mrr
        ) AS is_downgrade_cancellation
    FROM starting_subs ss
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= (SELECT q_end FROM params) THEN mrr
                WHEN status = 'cancelled' AND is_downgrade_cancellation THEN mrr
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS retained_mrr
    FROM subs_with_next
)
SELECT retained_mrr / NULLIF(starting_mrr, 0) AS gross_revenue_retention_q1_2026
FROM agg;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
ending AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS ending_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59')
      AND s.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ch.starting_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM cohort ch
LEFT JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = ch.customer_id;

)

FROM (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01') feb
CROSS JOIN (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01') mar;

    SELECT 'v3' AS version, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(mrr, 0) > 0 THEN mrr * 12.0 ELSE 0 END) AS arr

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS quarter_end
),
subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
        LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
quarter_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM subs s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    WHERE s.started_at < q.quarter_start
      AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, q.quarter_end) >= q.quarter_start
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM subs s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.quarter_end
      AND NOT (
          s.next_status = 'active'
          AND s.next_started_at IS NOT NULL
          AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(date_diff('day', CAST(s.ended_at AS DATE), CAST(s.next_started_at AS DATE))) <= 1
      )
)
SELECT
    q.quarter_start,
    q.quarter_end,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS customers_at_start_of_quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) AS churned_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id)
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_bounds q
LEFT JOIN quarter_cohort qc ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN true_churns tc
  ON tc.customer_id = qc.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2;

WITH cancelled_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), downgrade_cancellations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c1.sub_id
    FROM cancelled_subs c1
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s2
      ON s2.customer_id = c1.customer_id
     AND s2.status = 'active'
     AND s2.started_at BETWEEN c1.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day' AND c1.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND s2.mrr < c1.mrr
), v1 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_count
    FROM cancelled_subs
), corrected AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS true_churn_count
    FROM cancelled_subs c
    LEFT JOIN downgrade_cancellations d ON c.sub_id = d.sub_id
    WHERE d.sub_id IS NULL
), customer_signal_mismatch AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_without_customer_churn
    FROM cancelled_subs s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.churned_at IS NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT 'v1 counted every cancelled subscription as churn, including downgrade/replacement cancellations' AS issue, CAST(v.cancelled_count AS DOUBLE) AS value
    FROM v1 v
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'corrected true churn count after excluding downgrade/replacement cancellations' AS issue, CAST(c.true_churn_count AS DOUBLE) AS value
    FROM corrected c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'overcount from v1 due to downgrade/replacement cancellations' AS issue, CAST(v.cancelled_count - c.true_churn_count AS DOUBLE) AS value
    FROM v1 v CROSS JOIN corrected c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'percent overcount vs corrected churn' AS issue,
           CASE WHEN c.true_churn_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (v.cancelled_count - c.true_churn_count) / c.true_churn_count, 2) END AS value
    FROM v1 v CROSS JOIN corrected c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'cancelled subscriptions where customer-level churned_at is still NULL (shows customer/subscription signal disagreement)' AS issue,
           CAST(m.cancelled_without_customer_churn AS DOUBLE) AS value
    FROM customer_signal_mismatch m
) t;

    FROM customer_signal_mismatch m

WITH canonical_churn_events AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.ended_at AS churned_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
            AND s2.started_at BETWEEN s.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day' AND s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
            AND s2.mrr < s.mrr
      )
), quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
), quarter_starts AS (
    SELECT 'current_quarter' AS quarter_label, current_q_start AS quarter_start, next_q_start AS quarter_end
    FROM quarter_bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label, prev_q_start AS quarter_start, current_q_start AS quarter_end
    FROM quarter_bounds
), quarter_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        qs.quarter_label,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN s.started_at < qs.quarter_start
             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qs.quarter_start)
            THEN s.customer_id
        END) AS customers_at_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN ce.churned_at >= qs.quarter_start
             AND ce.churned_at < qs.quarter_end
            THEN ce.customer_id
        END) AS churned_customers
    FROM quarter_starts qs
    CROSS JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN canonical_churn_events ce
        ON ce.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    quarter_label,
    churned_customers,
    customers_at_start,
    CASE
        WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_metrics
ORDER BY CASE quarter_label WHEN 'previous_quarter' THEN 1 WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 2 END;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

churned_in_period AS (

  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-03-31 23:59:59+00' AS period_end
),
open_opps AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId') AS opp_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'deal_value', e.properties_jsonb->>'dealValue') AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e.timezone, 'UTC'), e."timestamp")) < p.period_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_events e2
      CROSS JOIN params p2
      WHERE COALESCE(e2.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e2.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
          = COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
        AND e2.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
        AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e2.timezone, 'UTC'), e2."timestamp")) < p2.period_end
    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio
FROM open_opps;

model_sql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY
),
matched_churn AS (
  SELECT sc.customer_id
  FROM starting_cohort sc
  INNER JOIN churned_in_period cp ON sc.customer_id = cp.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM matched_churn;

WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) AS cohort_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
quarterly_churns AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) AS cohort_quarter,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.ended_at) AS churn_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS churned_count
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
current_and_previous AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_quarter,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') AS previous_quarter
)
SELECT
    cp.current_quarter AS quarter,
    COALESCE(churned_count, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(cohort_size, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM current_and_previous cp
CROSS JOIN quarterly_cohorts qc
LEFT JOIN quarterly_churns qch
    ON qc.cohort_quarter = qch.cohort_quarter
    AND cp.current_quarter = qch.churn_quarter
WHERE qc.cohort_quarter = cp.current_quarter
UNION ALL
SELECT
    cp.previous_quarter AS quarter,
    COALESCE(churned_count, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(cohort_size, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM current_and_previous cp
CROSS JOIN quarterly_cohorts qc
LEFT JOIN quarterly_churns qch
    ON qc.cohort_quarter = qch.cohort_quarter
    AND cp.previous_quarter = qch.churn_quarter
WHERE qc.cohort_quarter = cp.previous_quarter
ORDER BY quarter DESC

  FROM fct_subscriptions

  FROM fct_subscriptions s

  CROSS JOIN most_recent_quarter q

WITH quarterly_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.churned_at) AS churn_quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS churned_customers
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.churned_at IS NOT NULL
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
),
active_customers AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.dt) AS quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(
      DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 quarter'),
      DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE),
      INTERVAL '1 quarter'
    )) AS dt
  ) d
  WHERE c.signup_date <= d.dt
    AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at > d.dt + INTERVAL '3 months')
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  a.quarter,
  COALESCE(q.churned_customers, 0) AS churned_customers,
  a.active_count AS customers_at_start,
  ROUND(COALESCE(q.churned_customers, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(a.active_count, 0), 4) AS churn_rate
FROM active_customers a
LEFT JOIN quarterly_metrics q ON a.quarter = q.churn_quarter
ORDER BY a.quarter DESC

WITH current_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 months' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS quarter_end
),
previous_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 day' AS quarter_end
),
current_qtr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'Current Quarter' AS period,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN current_quarter cq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= cq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at <= cq.quarter_end
),
previous_qtr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'Previous Quarter' AS period,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN previous_quarter pq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= pq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at <= pq.quarter_end
)

  CASE
    WHEN total_mrr > 0 THEN cancelled_mrr / total_mrr
    ELSE NULL
  END AS churn_rate
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM current_qtr_metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM previous_qtr_metrics
)
ORDER BY period DESC;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::float
              / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_lost'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',

  FROM fct_events
  WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT
  won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes
